name: Parsimony Stinginess
overview: Scripture reveals that parsimony or stinginess, especially in matters related to God's house and worship, leads to divine displeasure and tangible consequences. The people of Israel neglected the rebuilding of the temple, prioritizing their own comfort while the Lord's house lay waste, resulting in unfruitful labor and unmet needs (Haggai 1:2,4,6,9). Moreover, robbing God through withholding tithes and offerings brings a curse upon the nation (Malachi 3:8-9). These passages underscore the importance of faithful stewardship and generosity toward God’s work, warning against selfishness that damages both individual blessing and communal covenant faithfulness.
